observations.name: Road No. 36 initial Madhapur-to-Peddamma corridor: elevated Metro, divided carriageway and dense traffic
observations.notes: The connected opening chain shows a Metro deck/pier line above Road No. 36, station stair/access structures near Madhapur, raised planted median with occasional openings, paver/asphalt transitions and commercial frontage. Visible traffic includes many two-wheelers, cars, auto-rickshaws and service/delivery vehicles, plus pedestrians and a curbside counter/cart. The panorama sequence is only the opening roughly 200 m of a provisional 1.16 km station-shape interval, mainly forward road views; it does not inventory both sides, establish road widths, metric coverage, exact shop order or a verified station gate.
